originality.rationale: Primary source Panja 2611.09731 constructs the channel and fixed points but does not state its diagonal restricted point/Fredholm spectrum or beta critical eigenprojection norm. General shift/Fredholm and random bidiagonal tools are credited. Searches of accessible related research records and primary literature found no direct or stronger covering claim. Older deterministic-bidiagonal projection theory remains an explicit residual risk.
residual_risks: Older deterministic nonnormal bidiagonal operator theorems may imply a portion of the spectral and Riesz-projection assertions, notwithstanding no direct match found in searches.
The finite-state pure-birth comparison was abstract-level and cannot exclude all possible extensions to infinite ℓ∞ systems.
Only the canonical diagonal channel restriction is analyzed; other spectral components of the full UCP map are outside scope.

value.rationale: The canonical diagonal subalgebra is a motivated invariant of Panja’s new UCP channel. The all-radial exact point spectrum, sharp moment-ratio outlier count and explicit beta-weight Riesz projection condition numbers provide natural spectral invariants. Distinct odd-power divergences at successive spectral-island merger thresholds quantify an otherwise hidden nonnormal instability. The novel part goes beyond the generic shift disk or an arbitrary finite computation.
